title: The Damned Cartographer
text: A damned soul chained to a desk maps the Pit, forever, his quill scratching without pause. Every map he finishes is already wrong. The roads shift as he draws them, the rivers crawl, and he weeps quietly onto the parchment and starts again.

options.label: Buy his newest map, while it is still true.

outcomes.text: It holds true for a day. Then the roads begin to crawl again, and somewhere behind you he is weeping.

options.label: The kindest unchains him from his desk, and ends his endless labour.

outcomes.text: He draws one last map, a true one. Smiling for the first time in centuries, he fades.

options.label: Steal his maps. He will only draw more.

outcomes.text: In your pack they change into maps of nowhere. Nowhere has teeth.
